decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Approval

The single storey rear extension, by way of its position, size, design, scale, appearance and rearward location, does not harm the character of the dwelling and the locality or neighbours' living conditions and therefore complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan; and is generally compliant with the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.  It is considered that where the development is not compliant no undue adverse effects result.
Condition : 2 - No flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
